newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 484.80/485.80/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 484.80/485.80/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed softer in light trade after a late spurt in dollar demand from the interbank market was only partially met by Central Bank dollar sales, traders said.
The dollar closed Thursday at 484.50/485.50 per dollar.
"It was only at the end of the day that the bolivar softened," said one trader. "Some banks were left short dollars, but the Central Bank only came into the market gently," he added.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
